prompts.name: Faith

Preserve existing recognizable facial geometry, age, skin tone, eye direction, expression and all features except requested changes. Entire hair, chin and accessories must fit fully with generous transparent margins all around; zoom out as needed for long hair. No neck, torso, shoulders, clothes, text, watermark or checkerboard. Remove the maroon sun hat and its ribbon COMPLETELY. Replace tight curls with MEDIUM-LENGTH BLACK hair that is mostly smooth with gentle loose waves, clearly SIDE-PARTED, no bangs. Add one small visible maroon HAIR CLIP at the side. Change BLUE irises to BROWN, keeping open eyes looking image LEFT and happy open-mouth toothy smile. No hat, no bow, no glasses.
